payload.reason: The evidence specifies the range of the probability value (p) used in the binomial distribution for token replacement during data augmentation.

claims.text: The probability of replacing a token when using the binomial distribution is tuned over the range from 0.1 to 0.7.
The p value for the binomial distribution is incremented in steps of 0.2 within the specified range.
A binomial distribution is used to randomly decide whether a token should be replaced.
